stories.title: Papa León XIV llama a "tomar en serio" advertencias de expertos sobre la IA; critica "paraíso de las máquinas"

en.title: Pope Leo XIV calls to "take seriously" expert warnings on AI; criticizes "machine paradise"
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV urges careful consideration of risks identified by AI specialists while rejecting panic, characterizing the potential unchecked advancement of artificial intelligence as irresponsible to ignore.

stories.title: El papa León pide "tomar en serio" las preocupaciones sobre la IA

en.title: Pope Leo calls to "take seriously" concerns about AI
en.summary: Debate over artificial intelligence risks has intensified recently following various incidents and warnings from industry experts.

stories.title: Morena elige a Ana Lilia Rivera como coordinadora en Tlaxcala rumbo a las elecciones de 2027

en.title: Morena selects Ana Lilia Rivera as coordinator in Tlaxcala heading toward 2027 elections
en.summary: Ana Lilia Rivera, a former senator, was chosen as Morena's coordinator in Tlaxcala for the upcoming 2027 elections after an internal party contest.

stories.title: Sheinbaum ordena reforzar seguridad en Morelos tras asesinato de dos estudiantes de la UAEM

en.title: Sheinbaum orders security reinforcement in Morelos following murder of two UAEM students
en.summary: President Sheinbaum directed enhanced security measures in Morelos and Cuernavaca following the killing of two preparatory school students from UAEM.

stories.title: EU revoca visas de jueces, altos funcionarios y empresarios de 4 países de AL; los acusa de corrupción y vínculos con el narco

en.title: EU revokes visas of judges, senior officials and businesspeople from 4 Latin American countries; accuses them of corruption and links to drug trafficking
en.summary: The European Union has revoked visas for judges, high-ranking officials, and business figures from four Latin American countries, citing corruption and organized crime connections as part of commitments made under an alliance framework.

stories.title: Fiscalía de Morelos coordinará investigación por asesinato de dos estudiantes de la UAEM; alcalde de Cuernavaca admite fallas en seguridad

en.title: Morelos Prosecutor's Office coordinates investigation into murder of two UAEM students; Cuernavaca mayor admits security failures
en.summary: Authorities are investigating the deaths of two university students in Morelos state. The local mayor acknowledged security shortcomings and announced a review of municipal security personnel within two weeks.

stories.title: EU cancela visas de altos cargos y jueces de Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador y Perú

en.title: US cancels visas of senior officials and judges from Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador and Peru
en.summary: The United States cancelled visas for judges, high-ranking officials, and business figures from four South American countries accused of corruption, drug trafficking connections, or conspiracy against their governments.

en.summary: Ana Lilia Rivera has been appointed as Morena's political choice in Tlaxcala in a coordination role focused on transformation initiatives.

stories.title: Polo will make landfall in Baja California Sur today. What you need to know

en.title: Polo will make landfall in Baja California Sur today. What you need to know
en.summary: Hurricane Polo, a Category 3 storm with winds of approximately 185 kilometers per hour, is expected to make landfall in Baja California Sur before 6 p.m. today, with gusts reaching up to 220 kilometers per hour.

stories.title: Huracán Polo sigue como categoría 3 y tormenta tropical Rachel avanza; sigue EN VIVO su avance y efectos

en.title: Hurricane Polo continues as Category 3; tropical storm Rachel advances; tracking live updates and impacts
en.summary: Hurricane Polo maintains maximum winds of 185 km/h while approaching Baja California Sur, while tropical storm Rachel brings heavy rainfall to Guerrero and Oaxaca.

stories.title: El megacohete de Elon Musk alcanza la órbita por primera vez y abre una nueva era para SpaceX rumbo a la Luna

en.title: Elon Musk's megamissile reaches orbit for the first time and opens a new era for SpaceX toward the Moon
en.summary: SpaceX's large rocket has achieved orbital flight after years of testing and failures, advancing toward a vehicle capable of carrying cargo, refueling in space, and supporting future NASA missions.

stories.title: México eleva 40.4% sus exportaciones en agosto; registra superávit comercial de 605 mdd

en.title: Mexico raises 40.4% its exports in August; registers trade surplus of 605 million dollars
en.summary: Mexico's exports increased significantly in August, driven by electrical and electronic equipment sales, though automotive exports declined during the period.

stories.title: El peso queda atrapado entre la Fed y la deuda récord de Estados Unidos

en.title: The peso remains trapped between the Fed and record U.S. debt
en.summary: Interest rate adjustments in the United States and Japan pose risks to trading strategies favoring the peso, with investors reducing their exposure to the currency.

stories.title: La promesa de los 21 contratos mixtos de Pemex se topa con las dudas del sector privado

en.title: The promise of Pemex's 21 mixed contracts faces private sector doubts
en.summary: Pemex is pursuing mixed contracts to reach a target of 450,000 barrels daily by 2033, but only four of nine signed contracts show operational progress so far.
